key_idea: Check what the row and the column of the colored cell still need.
steps: The colored cell is in the bottom row and the right column.
The bottom row has a sun with 2 and a star with 3. It still needs a moon and the number 1.
The right column has a sun with 3, so a moon with 1 fits there too.

choice_feedback.A: The bottom row already has a star and a 2.
choice_feedback.B: The bottom row already has a sun, and the right column already has a 3.
choice_feedback.C: The bottom row already has a star.
choice_feedback.D: The bottom row already has a 2.
